responsibility: Implements the Windows-specific C++ target support for applying dllimport and dllexport semantics to classes and their members on x86 PE/COFF targets. It decides when function and variable declarations are eligible for import/export markings, suppresses those markings for inline/template/artificial cases that should not follow PE class rules, and propagates class-level attributes to members, thunks, vtables, and typeinfo declarations during C++ class definition processing.
